2701-3110-7182-7252.easyPrerequisites: "Grave Sifter" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
2701-3110-7182-7252.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Council of the Absolute
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-7084-8232.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1657-6431.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Murderous Redcap enters, it and Celes trigger.
Resolve the Celes trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing damage to itself equal to its power.
Repeat from step 3.

1394-2060-3967-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

423-1437-3177-3478--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3177-3478--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3165-3532-5078-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra and Longshot trigger.
Resolve the Managorger Hydra trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1020-1796-2034-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

1849-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1849-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

549-1978-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
549-1978-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

1856-2034-3490-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1856-2034-3490-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1742-2035-5477.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gollum, adding {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat.

1636-4770-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Whitemane Lion between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
1636-4770-6406.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4770-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

759-1247-1648-5963-6549.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

3015-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, ultimately milling God-Eternal Rhonas.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2018-3216-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

997-2018-3216.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1537-2440-4183-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts
1537-2440-4183-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Zealous Conscripts for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Gemstone Array twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2423-2440-4055-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis
2423-2440-4055-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2440-5200-5917.easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to The Jolly Balloon Man.
2440-5200-5917.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
You control at least three creatures that are either Balloons or that share a creature type with the nonlegendary creature.
2440-5200-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

2428-4067-5874.notablePrerequisites:
Sphinx of the Revelation does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {W} and a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2428-4067-5874.description:
Activate Sphinx of the Revelation by paying {W}{U}{U}, tapping it and paying at least {E}{E}{E}{E}, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Horizon Chimera triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Horizon Chimera trigger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx of the Revelation.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {W} or {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W} or {U}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have {W}{U}{U} available.
Repeat from step 1.
You may pay additional {E} if able to net near-infinite card draw.

804-5231-5756.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor, adding {R}.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-4812-5145.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3263-4659-4887.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Launch, adding {2}.
Launch triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Launch by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

2104-3198-5265.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one other card in hand.
2104-3198-5265.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Imaginary Pet by paying {1}{U}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Imaginary Pet.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Imaginary Pet triggers, returning itself and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2000-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
2000-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Gixian Infiltrator triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

273-4944.description:
Activate Shuko's ability targeting Crackdown Construct.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1750-2365-4903-5261.description:
Cast your Expropriate and vote for extra turn.
Move to extra turn.
Tap isochron to move your extra turn spell from exile to your graveyard.
Attack with Backdraft Hellkite to give your extra turn flashback, then cast it.
